statements.statement: Pulling the chip select (CS) line HIGH activates an SPI peripheral device.
statements.explanation: Pulling CS LOW activates the device, not HIGH. Keeping CS HIGH makes the device ignore all traffic on the bus.

statements.statement: Multiple SPI devices share the SCLK, MOSI, and MISO wires but each requires its own separate CS wire.
statements.explanation: To connect multiple SPI devices, you share SCLK, MOSI, and MISO across all of them but run a separate CS wire to each one, costing one GPIO pin per device.

statements.statement: Adding more SPI devices to a bus does not require any additional GPIO pins.
statements.explanation: Every additional SPI device costs one more GPIO pin for its dedicated CS line. This is the trade-off of connecting multiple devices over SPI.
